ICC Docket 323, 17 Ind. Cl. Comm. 162 (July 26, 1966, OSU id 1044): 1888 and 1889 acts confirmed reservation title in the Poncas of Nebraska and provided for allotment, then an executive order extinguishing title to unallotted land; the 27,235.90 allotted acres were partial delayed compensation for the uncompensated loss through the 1868 Sioux treaty. The act is dated April 30, 1888 (25 Stat. 94), not April 13.

Final Award on Remand, 28 Ind. Cl. Comm. 335 (Aug. 23, 1972, OSU id 1572): 96,000 acres valued as of March 16, 1877 at $211,200; principal $174,327.06; $1,004,589.49 with interest to June 30, 1972. Matches the file.
